description: Per-request cost-tier dropdown ($ $$ $$$ $$$$ $$$$$) beside the YOLO/auto-approve control (user messages 6-10). The user wants Zoo to request a cost tier per request and have it GRANTED on the OmniRoute side via the request itself (not a management lockdown). Ground it on OmniRoute's existing per-request steering layer (open-sse/services/autoCombo/requestControls.ts), which already resolves X-OmniRoute-Mode / X-OmniRoute-Budget headers purely and feeds them to the auto-combo engine WITHOUT mutating stored combo config. Add an X-OmniRoute-Tier header (values 1-5) resolver that raises the eligible-model ceiling up to the requested tier, mapping to the MODES ladder confirmed in omniroute-mode.py (1=local-only, 2=local-free, 3=local-light-paid, 4/5=cloud, 5=tiered). menagerie sends the header via its OmniRoute client; the webview dropdown is bound through cachedState per AGENTS.md. Absent header = unchanged behavior. Spans two repos; sequence last (independent of A-D but shares the OmniRoute branch). This is the largest FEAT — most work is in steps, not feature count.
steps: OmniRoute: in open-sse/services/autoCombo/requestControls.ts add a pure resolveRequestTier(input): parse X-OmniRoute-Tier into an integer ceiling 1-5 (reject anything else -> undefined so stored config stands), and thread it through resolveRequestAutoControls() alongside mode/budgetCap/budgetFallback. Wire the ceiling into the auto-combo engine's candidate filtering so a request with tier=N admits only models whose tier <= N (reuse the MODES/tier semantics; do not hardcode model lists). Follow the exact pattern of resolveRequestModePack/parseRequestBudgetCap.

OmniRoute: add a unit test (tests/unit/services or beside requestControls) asserting resolveRequestTier parses 1-5, rejects 0/6/'x'/empty, and that a request carrying X-OmniRoute-Tier:3 admits tier<=3 candidates and excludes tier-5-only ones; absent header leaves the combo's own config unchanged. Commit on OmniRoute branch feat/hybrid-reader-combo (do NOT push).

menagerie types: add an omniRouteTier setting (integer 1-5, optional, default undefined meaning 'use server default') in packages/types/src/global-settings.ts (or the provider settings schema), and include it in ExtensionState in packages/types/src/vscode-extension-host.ts and the relevant updateSettings message type. Define a shared default constant if multiple readers need it.

menagerie webview: add a compact 5-step selector rendering $ $$ $$$ $$$$ $$$$$ as a new control in webview-ui/src/components/chat/ChatTextArea.tsx placed immediately beside AutoApproveDropdown.tsx (reuse the existing dropdown/select styling in chatControlStyles.ts and the AutoApproveDropdown structure). Bind its value to local cachedState (NOT live useExtensionState) per AGENTS.md; update cachedState on change and include omniRouteTier in the updateSettings payload from handleSubmit (or document a deliberate immediate-save flow). Only show the control when the active profile isOmniRoute(configuration).

menagerie host: in src/core/webview/webviewMessageHandler.ts persist omniRouteTier via contextProxy.setValue (generic setting), add it to ClineProvider.getState() with the intended default, and add it to BOTH the destructuring and the returned object in ClineProvider.getStateToPostToWebview() so the saved value round-trips to the webview.

menagerie request path: in src/api/providers/omniroute.ts (and wherever the OmniRoute chat request headers are assembled from DEFAULT_HEADERS / the provider options) attach `X-OmniRoute-Tier: <omniRouteTier>` when the setting is set and the profile isOmniRoute; omit the header entirely when unset (so OmniRoute keeps its default). Thread omniRouteTier from provider settings to that header.

menagerie tests: add webview-ui tests for the dropdown binding/save (value shows from cachedState, change updates cachedState, Save includes omniRouteTier) and an extension-host/unit test that a set omniRouteTier reaches getStateToPostToWebview() and produces the X-OmniRoute-Tier header on the OmniRoute request (both set and unset cases). After editing each file, run the ESLint suppression ratchet and confirm no increase.
Commit menagerie changes on a new branch off the current green base (do NOT push). Do NOT add .changeset or edit CHANGELOG per AGENTS.md.
acceptance_criteria: OmniRoute: resolveRequestTier + wiring exist; a chat request with X-OmniRoute-Tier:3 admits tier<=3 models and excludes tier-5-only models; absent header preserves stored combo config; unit test passes.
menagerie: a $..$$$$$ dropdown renders beside the YOLO/auto-approve control, bound to cachedState, visible only for OmniRoute profiles.

The selected tier persists through the full round trip (types -> cachedState -> updateSettings -> webviewMessageHandler/ContextProxy -> getState -> getStateToPostToWebview) and emits X-OmniRoute-Tier on the OmniRoute request; unset emits no header.
No ESLint suppression count increases on any edited file; no .changeset/CHANGELOG edits.

cd /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/menagerie && pnpm --dir webview-ui test — the dropdown binding/save specs pass.
cd /Users/celes/sources/celesrenata/menagerie && pnpm --dir src test (narrowest suite covering webviewMessageHandler/ClineProvider round-trip + omniroute header) — passes.

findings:
Implemented across both repos.

OmniRoute (branch feat/hybrid-reader-combo, commit 8d9d5f7a8): added pure resolveRequestTier(input) in open-sse/services/autoCombo/requestControls.ts (integer 1-5 ceiling, else undefined so stored combo config stands) and threaded it through resolveRequestAutoControls as tierCeiling. Wired a tierCeiling field into AutoComboConfig and selectProvider() (engine.ts): candidates are filtered via classifyTier() against the ceiling, mapping the 1-5 MODES ladder onto the existing free/cheap/premium tier bands (1-2=free, 3=+cheap, 4-5=all) with no hardcoded model lists; the empty-pool self-healing fallback still honors the ceiling. resolveAutoStrategy.ts resolves relayOptions.tierCeiling and passes it into selectAutoProvider. Unit test tests/unit/services/requestTier.test.ts (node:test) covers parse 1-5 / reject 0,6,'x',empty; tier=3 excludes a premium-only candidate; tier=1 admits only free; absent ceiling leaves the full pool. Verified: npm run test:unit services glob (368 pass incl. 6 new), vitest autoCombo engine suite (63 pass), npm run typecheck:core clean. Note: tests/unit/autoCombo/** are vitest-only (vi.mock) and error under node:test — pre-existing harness split, not in the test:unit glob.

menagerie (new branch feat/omniroute-tier-dropdown-feat005): omniRouteTier modeled as a global setting (packages/types/src/global-settings.ts, shared omniRouteTierSchema + OMNIROUTE_TIER_COUNT), added to ExtensionState (vscode-extension-host.ts) and also to the OpenAI provider schema so it rides ApiHandlerOptions to the request path. updateSettings already persists it via contextProxy.setValue; ClineProvider.getState() returns omniRouteTier and injects it onto the active profile only when isOmniRoute (and strips it otherwise, since omniRouteTier is also a provider-settings key surfaced by getProviderSettings for every OpenAI profile); getStateToPostToWebview() destructures and returns it. Request path: omniRouteRequestHeaders() in src/api/providers/omniroute.ts emits X-OmniRoute-Tier only for an OmniRoute profile with a valid 1-5 tier (omitted otherwise); OpenAiHandler merges it into defaultHeaders. Webview: new webview-ui/src/components/chat/OmniRouteTierDropdown.tsx renders $..$$$$$ (+ Default) beside AutoApproveDropdown in ChatTextArea, visible only for OmniRoute profiles, saved immediately via updateSettings (the deliberate immediate-save flow the sibling YOLO/auto-approve control uses; chat toolbar, not SettingsView, so the cachedState buffer rule does not apply here). Tests: OmniRouteTierDropdown.spec.tsx (6, binding/save/unset/visibility), omniroute.spec.ts header cases, openai.spec.ts handler header set/unset/non-OmniRoute, ClineProvider.spec.ts round-trip set/unset/non-OmniRoute. Verified directly: webview tier spec (6 pass), src omniroute+openai+ClineProvider+webviewMessageHandler suites (537 pass), src/webview typecheck clean, eslint --prune-suppressions --max-warnings=0 clean with no count increase on every edited src file (the whitespace-only reformat the prune emits on src/eslint-suppressions.json was reverted). No .changeset/CHANGELOG edits.
